"""One-shot eai-standard/2.2 RoboPaint episode controller and trajectory record."""
import sys, os, math, json, time, pathlib
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
RUNS=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
R=Robot()
SPEC=R.spec()

def status():
    print(json.dumps(R.status()))

def current_pose():
    o=R.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none')
    return np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], dtype=float)

def path_rows(waypoints, dt=0.05, speed=0.12):
    """Linear dense targets (xyz plus constant quaternion); each waypoint=(xyz,quat)."""
    rows=[]
    for (p0,q0),(p1,q1) in zip(waypoints[:-1],waypoints[1:]):
        p0=np.asarray(p0,float); p1=np.asarray(p1,float); q0=np.asarray(q0,float); q1=np.asarray(q1,float)
        n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p1-p0)/(speed*dt))))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            a=i/n; q=(1-a)*q0+a*q1; q=q/np.linalg.norm(q)
            rows.append(np.r_[(1-a)*p0+a*p1,q])
    return np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32)

def move_to(p, q=None, speed=0.12, dt=0.05, note='move'):
    cur=current_pose()
    if q is None: q=cur[3:]
    q=np.asarray(q,float); q=q/np.linalg.norm(q)
    rows=path_rows([(cur[:3],cur[3:]),(np.asarray(p,float),q)],dt,speed)
    r=R.submit('ee_pose',rows,dt=dt,video='both',note=note)
    print('move',note,'rows',len(rows),'plan',r.meta.get('plan'),'clipped',r.meta.get('clipped'))
    return r

if __name__=='__main__':
    print('initial_status',R.status())
    print('initial_pose',current_pose().tolist())
    q=np.array([0,1,0,0.],float)
    for p in ([0,0,0.32],[-0.10,0,0.32]):
        ik=R.ik({'tip':[float(p[0]),float(p[1]),float(p[2]),*q]},seed=R.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][:7])
        print('ik',p,ik.get('ok'),ik.get('error'))
    a=move_to([0,0,0.32],note='clear above start')
    a.save('/app/runs/000')
    b=move_to([-0.10,0,0.32],note='clear over sheet center')
    b.save('/app/runs/001')
    o=R.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=True,video='none')
    for c,img in o.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(img).save(str(OUT/f'clear_{c}.png'))
    np.save('/app/output/clear_canvas_depth.npy',o.last_depth['canvas_cam'])
    print('pose',o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])
    print('status',R.status())
